oneOf.description:
A session's current state for the fleet index; sent for every session after the vault's
hello, then whenever any of it changes. Replaces what the vault had for the session.
Consecutive journal events of one session.
An image a `user_message` of the next batch names; sent just before that batch.

Attachment.description: An image a prompt carried, kept on the session's host.

size.description: Size of the image in bytes.

AttachmentData.description: The bytes of an image a prompt of a session carried.

attachment.description:
The image as the `user_message` names it. The vault refuses it as a bad request unless
`media_type` is one of [`crate::IMAGE_MEDIA_TYPES`] and `size` is the length of `data`,
at most [`crate::MAX_IMAGE_BYTES`], or when it holds different bytes under its id.

session_id.description: Session whose prompt carried the image.

AttachmentId.description: Identifies an image a prompt carried, within its session; a ULID string, opaque.

Batch.description: Events of one session with consecutive seqs, oldest first.

events.description: One to [`MAX_BATCH_EVENTS`] events, each seq one more than the one before.

session_id.description: Session whose journal holds the events.

Bytes.description: Raw bytes, encoded as a standard padded base64 string.

CiStatus.description: Combined status of a pull request's checks.

HostHello.description: Opening message of a host connection.

build.description: Build name and version, for logs, e.g. `herder/0.1.0`.

host_id.description: The host; must be the host this connection's device was paired as.

pairing_code.description:
One-time code from the vault's pairing, sent by a host that is not paired yet; ignored
once it is.

HostId.description: Identifies a host running a daemon; a ULID string, opaque to receivers.

JournalRecord.description: One event of a session's journal, exactly as the host stored it.

at.description: When the host recorded the event.

by.description: User whose command caused the event; absent when the agent or the daemon caused it.

seq.description: Position in the session's journal, gap-free from 1.

Mergeable.description: Whether a pull request can merge cleanly.

oneOf.description: GitHub has not computed it yet.

PrState.description: Lifecycle state of a pull request.

ProjectId.description:
Identifies a project across hosts.

From a remote, it is the host and repository path, as in `github.com/org/repo`. For a
repository without one, it is the host id and absolute path, as in
`01J9HOST:/home/dev/scratch`.

PullRequest.description: A GitHub pull request tracked for a session.

head_branch.description:
Branch the pull request merges from, as a short name; absent from events journaled
before herder recorded it.

RawEventBody.description: An event body exactly as the host stored it: an `EventBody` of the client protocol (see `server_message.json`), or a type newer than the receiver, kept verbatim.

ReviewStatus.description: Review verdict on a pull request.

SessionId.description: Identifies a session; a ULID string, opaque to receivers.

SessionStatus.description: Where a session stands, as shown in lists.

oneOf.description: The agent is working, or waiting for its primary session to answer an approval or question.

A prompt waits for host capacity or its reported usage reset (retry_at); the turn starts, and the
status becomes `running`, once it does. Survives a daemon restart, and the prompt keeps
its place in the host's queue.
Blocked on a user: an approval or question routed or escalated to the user, or a failed turn to act on.
Put away by a user; read-only.
Handed off to another host; read-only here.

SessionSummary.description: A session as the fleet index lists it.

branch.description: Branch the session's worktree has checked out, or had when it was removed.

head_seq.description: Seq of the session's latest event on the host; the vault is caught up once it holds it.

parent.description: Primary session of the task this session is a child of; absent for a top-level session.

project_id.description: Project of the session's repository, as resolved under the host's current config.

prs.description: Every pull request tracked for the session.

repo.description: Absolute path of the repository on the host.

task.description: Short label of the session's task.

title.description: The session's current title; absent until it has one.

UserId.description: Identifies a named user of a daemon; a ULID string, opaque to receivers.
